charaepi_ch0286_80_svboy/2301_1101_0100_:
[Name:PlayerNickname ] finished a
Pokémon battle against Florian’s Yanmega.
charaepi_ch0286_80_svboy/2301_1201_0300_:
Having Pokémon battles with you is fun,
[Name:PlayerNickname ]! There’s always
new things to discover and learn!
charaepi_ch0286_80_svboy/2301_1201_0400_: Wasn’t my teamwork with Yanmega perfect?
charaepi_ch0286_80_svboy/2301_1201_0500_: I just get how Yanmega feels somehow!
charaepi_ch0286_80_svboy/2301_1201_0600_:
Maybe it’s because we’ve been together
since we met in Kitakami.
charaepi_ch0286_80_svboy/2301_1201_0700_: I was there for a school trip.
charaepi_ch0286_80_svboy/2301_1201_0800_:
I had to take a plane and a bus from
Paldea...
charaepi_ch0286_80_svboy/2301_1201_0900_:
And when I got off the bus, I was
surrounded by rice fields! Nature as far
as the eye can see!
charaepi_ch0286_80_svboy/2301_1201_1000_:
The air was fresh, and the Pokémon were in
great spirits.
charaepi_ch0286_80_svboy/2301_1201_1100_:
On my way from the bus stop to Mossui
Town, I ran into Yanma.
charaepi_ch0286_80_svboy/2301_1201_1200_:
He looked so cool, flying around all that
nature at top speed. I was in awe.
charaepi_ch0286_80_svboy/2301_1201_1300_:
After that, we adventured through Kitakami
together. Then he evolved into Yanmega!
charaepi_ch0286_80_svboy/2301_1201_1400_:
I have fond memories of racing each other
over fields and mountains, exploring
riverbanks, valleys, and caves!
charaepi_ch0286_80_svboy/2301_1201_1500_:
Even on Pasio, when I visit a spot with
nature, I remember those times.
charaepi_ch0286_80_svboy/2301_1201_1600_:
I plan to go on lots of adventures with
Yanmega here too.
charaepi_ch0286_80_svboy/2301_1201_1700_:
I do want to rely on my own two legs when
I sightsee...
charaepi_ch0286_80_svboy/2301_1201_1800_:
but I also want Yanmega to carry me so I
can see Pasio from above!
charaepi_ch0286_80_svboy/2301_1201_1900_:
There may be things visible from the sky that
can’t be spotted on land!
charaepi_ch0286_80_svboy/2301_0401_2100_: Great! I’ll ask Yanmega to bring you along!
charaepi_ch0286_80_svboy/2301_1201_2400_:
My Yanmega is strong. I’m sure he can carry
us both!
charaepi_ch0286_80_svboy/2301_1201_2700_: All right. Let’s go fly together!
